title: Technical Consultant - Android
description:
We are looking for Android Developer with 3-5 years experience in Coimbatore.

This is a position suitable for proactive individuals who are willing to work both in a team and on their own, able to organise themselves and manage deadlines with minimum supervision.

**Company Profile :**

Comgen has collectively 15 years growing organisation located at Singapore as Simplr Solution Pte. Ltd. and offshore development center as Comgen India Software Solution Pvt. Ltd. at Coimbatore.

**Website details:**

www.comgensg.com

**Working location: Coimbatore**

**Android**

* Proven experience as an Android Developer (Java and/or Kotlin).
* Strong knowledge of Android SDK, Android Studio, and Gradle.
* Experience with RESTful APIs, JSON, and third-party integrations.
* Familiarity with Firebase (Crashlytics, Analytics, Push Notifications)
* Experience in publishing and managing apps on the Google Play Store.
* Solid understanding of mobile app lifecycle, memory management, and performance optimization.
* Knowledge of version control tools (Git).
* Knowledge of cross-platform frameworks (Flutter, React Native) is a plus.

**SQL**

* Proven experience as an SQL Developer or similar role.
* Strong proficiency in SQL (T-SQL/PL-SQL) and relational database systems (MS SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, or PostgreSQL).
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Good communication and teamwork abilities

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
